scope: Finite floating-point checks; no universal proof, interval certificate, Lean certification, or external peer review.

definition_sources.original: Hirche, Guan and Tomamichel, arXiv:2305.02589v1, IV.1-IV.2 and V.1-V.8
definition_sources.core_note: Related order-four calculation in the manuscript.
definition_sources.primary_computation: Original cq blocks; dense XOR/CNOT output; independent spectral matrix powers
definition_sources.biased_prior_scope: Additional algebraic extension checked here; the cited paper states its channel conjecture for equiprobable bits.

numerical_policy.comparison_rule: abs(error) <= atol + rtol*abs(scale), or inequality slack >= -(atol+rtol*abs(scale))
numerical_policy.support_rule: For every PSD power, diagonalize the Hermitian part; eigenvalues <= 1e-12*largest_abs_eigenvalue are set to zero. Negative powers act only on the retained support.
numerical_policy.positive_spectrum_rule: Intended full-rank random states receive 0.03*I/d spectral regularization; constructed singular states have exact support zeros before floating-point embedding.
numerical_policy.arithmetic: IEEE float64/complex128 NumPy dense linear algebra; no rigorous rounding enclosure
